name: Local public-service offices (utilities, engineering, social services, cooperatives, fisheries) — Sylhet Division
organization: Various government departments and state-owned utilities (each row's organisation in extra_json.organisation)
attribution: Office lists published by the departments and state-owned utilities on their own websites (see urls)
notes: REB rows also use the 80 PBS websites (pbs[N].<district>.gov.bd) linked from REB's PBS list. Each row is an office exactly as its organisation lists it (state-owned utilities' own sites counted as government). District/upazila normalised to the seed's English names (published values in extra_json). No coordinates are published by these lists. Only office names, addresses, office landlines, complaint-centre / hotline / customer-service numbers and official e-mails are kept; officers' names and mobiles are never collected. Categories are the closest existing keys; extra_json.proposed_category holds a proposed sub-key. No licence stated: factual data only. Checked and not used: BPDB distribution offices (the distribution-zone page names four zones only (Chittagong, Comilla, Sylhet, Mymenshing) with no offices or addresses; the zone contact list is a PDF of officers' mobile numbers); PBS complaint centres (অভিযোগ কেন্দ্র) (each of the 80 PBS sites words them differently (free text, mixed tables, one page per zonal office listing staff); only REB's PBS hotline list and the zonal / sub-zonal offices named in the PBS sites' menus and office-list pages are used); Rajshahi WASA (domain does not resolve (rwasa.org.bd / rwasa.gov.bd), no other official site found); Narayanganj WASA (no official website found); Khulna WASA (the site has no zone-office or contact list (menu 'যোগাযোগ' is empty)); DPHE district / upazila offices (no office list on the department's site (only the head office address)); BRTA circle offices (the divisional circle lists are PDF attachments only (stdlib + requests collector: PDFs not parsed)); Department of Livestock Services (division / district / upazila office lists and domain-mail lists are PDF attachments only); Department of Youth Development (64 district offices and the e-mail list are PDF attachments; the 'web portal links' page links to further pages per division only); Department of Women Affairs (upazila officer / programme officer lists are PDF attachments only); Bangladesh Election Commission (robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot / anthropic-ai and sets 'Content-Signal: ai-train=no'; not collected (no office list was found on the two pages read before the robots.txt was checked)); Union Digital Centres (no public national list of centre locations found (entrepreneur lists are out of scope)); BADC (no office list (only officer lists and projects)); BSCIC (regional / district office addresses and phones are a PDF attachment; the district-office page links only to staff lists); NGO Affairs Bureau registered NGOs (the list of registered NGOs is a PDF attachment only); DESCO www host (TLS certificate does not cover www.desco.gov.bd; desco.gov.bd used instead).
